lines: She put her tea down. I have worked this floor nine years and I have seen her do that once.
Eight. That is the whole set and there is nowhere further to take them until the gate opens.
Sit at the lights a minute. Everybody does, afterwards, and nobody plans to.
She keeps a book a year on everyone who comes up. Not who won. What they brought.
Forty volumes. I have read three and I had to stop, because she is very kind in them.
